content.short: ve(3,3) MetaDEX on Unichain built on Uniswap v4 with automated liquidity management.
content.description: Catex serves Unichain projects that need liquidity. It routes swaps through Uniswap v4 pools, manages liquidity positions automatically, and uses a ve(3,3) model where users lock CATX as veCATX to vote on which pools receive emissions and to earn a share of fees and incentives. Protocols can bribe voters to direct liquidity towards their own pairs.
content.meta: Lock CATX on Catex, a ve(3,3) MetaDEX on Unichain, to steer Uniswap v4 liquidity and earn fees and incentives.
